root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly assumes that the number of FIFO entries reported by the hardware status register is always a multiple of the number of enabled scan elements (fifo_set_size), but the sensor fills FIFO one sample at a time, so an unaligned count can cause the interrupt handler to read more entries than are actually present in the FIFO.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "the number of entries reported by the FIFO status registers may not be a multiple of N; if this number is not a multiple, the number of entries read from the FIFO may exceed the number of entries actually present." The patch applies `rounddown(fifo_entries, st->fifo_set_size)` to ensure the read count is aligned.
